Plot SVG statistic for selected genes

Source: R/svg_marker.R
plot_svg_stat.Rd

Plot SVG statistic for selected genes

Usage

plot_svg_stat(
  svg_norm,
  genes,
  stat = "LR_stat",
  method_order = NULL,
  method_colors = NULL,
  transform = c("log1p", "log", "none"),
  point_size = 3,
  gene_id = "rownames",
  theme_name = "classic"
)

Arguments

svg_norm

Named list of SVG results.

genes

Genes to plot.

stat

SVG statistic.

method_order

Optional method order.

method_colors

Optional named vector of method colours.

transform

Transformation: log1p, log, or none.

point_size

Point size.

gene_id

Gene identifier.

theme_name

Plot theme.

Value

A list containing data and plot.
